laptop, commander · fleets home (default), work ·
  no app checkout here → fleet home (commander.default_fleet)

A task is a list of items in one YAML file, each item a check that says
whether the machine is already the way it should be and a command that makes it
so. The runner types them where the machine is: 'caramelo task run' on the box
it changes, never over a wire.

'task show' prints the file that will run, so what a person reviews is exactly
what the machine does.

Usage:
  caramelo task [flags]
  caramelo task [command]

Examples:
  caramelo task list
  caramelo task show commander-setup
  caramelo task run commander-setup --dry-run


Available Commands:
  list        List the tasks this binary carries
  run         Run a task on this machine
  show        Print the task file that will run, byte for byte

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for task

Global Flags:
      --fleet string      fleet to talk to, by its name in the commander config (default: the app's fleet, then the default fleet)
      --json              print machine-readable JSON on stdout
      --machine string    raw ssh target to talk to, for a machine that is in no fleet yet: user@host[:port], or 'local'
      --progress string   how progress is written to stderr: text (default) or json, one event per line

Use "caramelo task [command] --help" for more information about a command.
